text: 你沿浅溪涉水而行，那生物差点借此甩掉你，但你经验丰富，没有被这种伎俩骗过。你和诺曼一路追踪到高地。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 276
text: By wading along a shallow stream, the creature nearly shakes you off its trail, but you are too experienced to be foiled by such a trick. The pursuit takes you and Norman up into the high ground.
The prints become fresher as you climb.
